title: 第1214章 一剑之威绝望第1213章 都后退
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
只见天空裂开的边缘，光滑得如同镜面。
没有空间乱流涌出。
没有混沌能量溢出。
什么都没有。
只有纯粹的、绝对的虚无。
一道剑气，从天空的裂缝中落下。
那剑气，看起来并不大。
只有三尺来长。
薄薄的，像是一道月牙。
甚至可以用精致二字来形容。
但就是这道看起来精致无比的剑气。
当它出现的那一刻。
整个无界疆域都在颤抖。
大地在龟裂。
高山在崩塌。
海洋在沸腾。
无数星辰，在剑气的威压下连一息都没有撑住。
直接爆碎。
像是被一只无形的大手捏爆的鸡蛋。
空间像碎玻璃一样寸寸崩塌。

密密麻麻的空间裂缝，朝着四面八方蔓延。
每一道空间裂缝，都足以吞噬一颗星辰。
时间在这一刻出现了断层。
所有人都有一种奇怪的感觉。
感觉自己的思维变得断断续续的。
上一秒的记忆和下一秒的记忆之间，有一片空白。
那片空白，就是被剑气斩断的时间。
所有人的心头，都升起了一种无法用言语形容的恐惧。
那是面对天威般的渺小感。
是蚂蚁面对巨象时的无力感。
是凡人面对神明时的卑微感。
那种感觉，比死亡还要可怕。
因为它让你连反抗的念头都无法升起。
脑子里只有一个想法——
逃！
但身体却不听使唤。
双腿像灌了铅一样沉重。
甚至连手指头都无法动弹。
那是死亡的气息。
是毁灭的气息。

万里之外的众人，看着那道剑气。
脸色全都变得煞白。
冰晶晶的身体在颤抖。
她的牙齿在打颤。
content_en:
All I could see was the cracked edge of the sky, as smooth as a mirror.
There is no space for turbulence to flow out.
No chaotic energy spilled out.
Nothing.
There is only pure, absolute nothingness.
A sword energy fell from the crack in the sky.
The sword energy doesn't look big.
Only three feet long.
Thin, like a crescent moon.
It can even be described as exquisite.
But it is this sword energy that looks extremely exquisite.
The moment it appears.
The entire unbounded territory is trembling.
The earth is cracking.
The mountains are crumbling.
The ocean is boiling.
Countless stars couldn't even hold on for a breath under the pressure of the sword energy.
Explodes directly.
Like an egg being crushed by an invisible hand.
The space collapsed inch by inch like broken glass.
Dense spatial cracks spread in all directions.
Every space crack is enough to swallow a star.
Time was interrupted at this moment.
Everyone has a strange feeling.
I feel like my thinking has become intermittent.
There is a blank space between the memory of one second and the memory of the next.
That blank space is the time cut off by the sword energy.
An indescribable fear arose in everyone's heart.
It was a feeling of insignificance in the face of the might of God.
It’s the ant’s feeling of powerlessness when facing the giant elephant.
It is the humble feeling that mortals feel when facing gods.
That feeling is more terrifying than death.
Because it prevents you from even thinking about resisting.
There is only one thought in my mind——
Escape!
But the body refused to obey.
My legs felt as heavy as lead.
I couldn't even move my fingers.
It was the smell of death.
It is the breath of destruction.
Everyone thousands of miles away looked at the sword energy.
All faces turned pale.
Bing Jingjing's body was trembling.
Her teeth were chattering.
